svg.aria-label: Runtime: Node.js 22 or newer, 24 LTS recommended. Build: TypeScript strict mode. Languages: Exports and import edges for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python and PHP (classes, interfaces, traits, enums, functions, constants; use statements resolved through composer.json PSR-4 maps). Other files are indexed with a summary only. Database: SQLite via better-sqlite3, WAL mode. 33 tables (27 scrum + 6 code). MCP protocol: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk. The server sends short MCP instructions (about 90 tokens) on when to use the graph tools. Dashboard: React 19 + Vite + Zustand + Framer Motion. CSS variables + Tailwind, dark theme. 75 React components. Live updates: SSE via WAL file watcher. Testing: Vitest. 1841 backend tests and 104 dashboard tests. Process: 9 agent roles (configurable). 4 sprint phases with gate checks + planning gate. 6 slash commands. CLI bins: 7: code-context (index), code-context-sprint (sprint process), code-context-mcp (setup), code-context-dashboard, code-context-statusline, code-context-reindex, code-context-sync-github. Alias: vlm-code-context-mcp = code-context
